mapper.insert: INSERT INTO site_user_first_seen (anon_id, first_seen_date) VALUES (#{anonId}, #{firstSeenDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE anon_id = anon_id
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN DATE(converted_at) = first_seen_date THEN 'immediate' ELSE 'returningThenSignup' END AS conversionType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM site_user_first_seen WHERE converted_at IS NOT NULL AND converted_at >= #{start} AND converted_at < #{end} + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY conversionType
